dispatch_consequence: One autopilot remains; CAT 3 DUAL not available
procedures: (O) Use the remaining autopilot
(O) CAT 3 DUAL not available: plan CAT 3 SINGLE minima at most
name: Autopilot (one of two)
plain: One of the two autopilots is broken. You can still use the other one
steps: Use the other autopilot
Autoland with both autopilots isn't available

procedures: (O) Manual thrust for the whole flight
(O) Approach limited to CAT 1: no low-visibility approaches
name: Autothrust
plain: The automatic thrust control is broken
steps: Set the thrust by hand for the whole flight
No fog landings

description: APU generator inoperative (APU bleed still available)
dispatch_consequence: No APU electrics: ground power needed on stand
procedures: (O) Use ground power on stand
(O) APU bleed may be used for engine start and air conditioning
name: APU generator
plain: The small engine in the tail can't make electricity
steps: Ask for a ground power cart at the gate

dispatch_consequence: APU generator runs for the whole flight: extra fuel
procedures: (M) Generator disconnected and secured
(O) APU generator on and used for the whole flight
(O) APU must be serviceable
name: Engine generator
plain: One engine's electrical generator is broken
steps: Run the tail engine (APU) for the whole flight to replace it
It burns a little extra fuel, already added to your plan

procedures: (M) Not dispatchable until inspected
(O) Check AC ESS SHED bus powered from the remaining sources before flight
name: Static inverter
plain: A backup electrical converter is broken
steps: Engineers check the backup power before the flight

dispatch_consequence: DC supply from the remaining TRs
procedures: (M) Remaining TRs checked operative
(O) Monitor DC bus supply on the ELEC page
name: Electrical converter
plain: One of the converters that make DC power is broken
steps: Engineers check the others work
Keep an eye on the electrical page

procedures: (O) Inform the cabin crew: reduced hot service on this galley
name: Galley power
plain: One of the kitchens has no power
steps: Let the cabin crew know: fewer hot drinks and meals

procedures: (M) Pump depressurised and secured
(O) Expect slower operation of the affected system's services
(O) PTU must be operative
name: Hydraulic pump
plain: One engine's hydraulic pump is switched off
steps: Flaps, gear or brakes may move more slowly on that system

dispatch_consequence: Blue system backed by the RAT only
procedures: (O) Blue system is supplied by the RAT only in an emergency
name: Blue hydraulic pump
plain: The electric pump of the blue hydraulic system is broken
steps: Nothing changes in normal flight

dispatch_consequence: No PTU backup between Green and Yellow
procedures: (O) No Green/Yellow cross-pressurisation
(O) Yellow electric pump used for cargo doors and parking brake accumulator
name: Hydraulic power transfer unit
plain: The unit that shares hydraulic power between systems is broken
steps: Expect no backup between the green and yellow systems

dispatch_consequence: Fuel management restrictions; small extra fuel
procedures: (O) Monitor fuel imbalance during the flight
(O) For a centre tank pump: plan centre tank fuel as possibly unusable
name: Fuel pump
plain: One fuel pump is broken
steps: Watch for uneven fuel between the wings
A small amount of extra fuel is added to your plan

procedures: (M) Valve secured closed
(O) Fuel balancing not available: load fuel symmetrically
name: Crossfeed valve
plain: The valve that moves fuel between wings is stuck closed
steps: Load the same fuel in both wings: you can't balance it in flight

procedures: (O) Not to be operated into known or forecast thunderstorm areas
name: Weather radar
plain: The weather radar is broken, so storms ahead can't be seen
steps: Don't fly into areas with thunderstorms

procedures: (O) Transponder must be operative
(O) Inform ATC; flight within the period allowed by the operator's MEL only
name: Collision avoidance (TCAS)
plain: The traffic collision warning system doesn't work
steps: Make sure the transponder works
Tell air traffic control

procedures: (O) Select the remaining transponder
name: Transponder (one of two)
plain: One of the two transponders is broken
steps: Use the other transponder

procedures: (O) Both PFDs and the three ADIRUs must be operative
name: Standby instruments
plain: The backup flight instrument is broken
steps: Both main screens and all three navigation units must work

procedures: (O) Use the remaining clock or FMGC time
name: Clock
plain: One of the cockpit clocks doesn't work
steps: Use the other clock

procedures: (O) Check the route and approaches do not need two DMEs
name: DME
plain: One of the distance-measuring radios is broken
steps: Use the other one

procedures: (O) Check the route and approaches do not need two VORs
name: VOR radio
plain: One VOR navigation radio is broken
steps: Navigate with the other one

procedures: (O) Approach limited to CAT 1: two ILS receivers are needed for CAT 2/3
name: ILS receiver
plain: One landing-guidance receiver is broken
steps: No fog landings: low-visibility approaches need both receivers

procedures: (M) ADIRU switched off
(O) Use ADIRU 3 by switching the affected side
(O) No RNP AR approaches
name: Navigation unit
plain: One of the three navigation units is broken
steps: Switch to the third unit
No special GPS approaches (RNP AR)

procedures: (O) Single FMGC operation: FMGC data on the affected side via the remaining unit
(O) CAT 3 DUAL not available
name: Flight management computer
plain: One of the two flight management computers is broken
steps: Use the other one for both sides
Autoland with both autopilots isn't available

procedures: (O) Use the display reversion switching for the affected unit
name: Display screen
plain: One cockpit display screen is broken
steps: Move its information to another screen

dispatch_consequence: Longer stopping distances; no contaminated runways
procedures: (M) Anti-skid deactivated
(O) Apply the anti-skid inoperative landing and take-off performance corrections
(O) Not on contaminated runways
name: Anti-skid brakes
plain: The anti-skid braking system is switched off
steps: Take-off and landing need more runway
Don't use snowy or icy runways

procedures: (M) Pack valve secured closed
(O) Maximum flight level FL315
(O) Remaining pack in HI flow if needed for cabin temperature
name: Air conditioning pack
plain: One of the two air conditioning units is broken
steps: Fly no higher than FL315
Already set in your SimBrief plan

dispatch_consequence: Ground power and air start needed at every stand
procedures: (O) Ground power and conditioned air on stand
(O) Engine start with an air start unit, or crossbleed start after the first engine
(O) No APU backup for electrics or bleed in flight
name: APU (tail engine)
plain: The small engine in the tail doesn't work
steps: Ask for a ground power cart and an air starter at every gate
Or start the second engine using air from the first

procedures: (M) Bleed valve secured closed
(O) Maximum flight level FL315
(O) Crossbleed open for wing anti-ice from the other side
name: Engine bleed
plain: One engine can't supply air to the aircraft systems
steps: Fly no higher than FL315

procedures: (M) Valve secured closed
(O) Not to be operated in known or forecast icing conditions
name: Wing anti-ice
plain: One wing's anti-ice system doesn't work
steps: Don't fly into icing conditions

dispatch_consequence: Engine anti-ice on all flight: extra fuel
procedures: (M) Valve secured open
(O) Engine anti-ice on for the whole flight: apply the performance penalty
name: Engine anti-ice
plain: One engine's anti-ice is stuck on
steps: Expect slightly lower performance; a little extra fuel is added

procedures: (M) Spoiler secured retracted
(O) Apply the take-off and landing performance corrections
name: Spoiler
plain: One spoiler panel on the wing doesn't work
steps: Take-off and landing need a bit more runway
A little extra fuel is added

dispatch_consequence: One reverser locked; no contaminated runways
procedures: (M) Reverser deactivated and locked stowed
(O) Landing distance without reverse on that engine
(O) Not on contaminated runways
name: Thrust reverser
plain: One engine's reverse thrust is locked out
steps: Plan the landing without reverse on that engine
Don't use snowy or icy runways

procedures: (M) Fuel quantity checked by measuring sticks before each departure
(O) Cross-check the uplift against the fuel receipt
(O) Carry 10 minutes of extra fuel for the indication uncertainty
name: Fuel gauge
plain: One tank's fuel gauge doesn't work
steps: Engineers measure the fuel by hand before each flight
10 minutes of extra fuel is added for safety

dispatch_consequence: No dispatch into rain or snow
procedures: (O) Not to be operated in precipitation at departure or destination
name: Windshield wiper
plain: One windshield wiper doesn't work
steps: Don't fly if it's raining or snowing at either airport

procedures: (O) Use the remaining landing light and the nose light for night operations
name: Landing light
plain: One landing light doesn't work
steps: Use the other lights at night

procedures: (O) Voice reports for OOOI times, load figures and clearances
(O) Departure clearance by voice
name: ACARS datalink
plain: The cockpit datalink to the airline doesn't work
steps: Send times and figures to the airline by radio instead

procedures: (M) Lavatory door locked and placarded
(O) Inform the cabin crew
name: Lavatory
plain: One toilet is out of order
steps: The door is locked and marked out of order
Let the cabin crew know

procedures: (O) Compartment empty, or loaded only with non-combustible cargo
(O) No live animals in that hold
name: Cargo hold smoke detector
plain: The smoke detector in one cargo hold doesn't work
steps: Keep that hold empty: put the bags in the other one
